name: Sucuri
summary: Website security for any CMS or host: a web application firewall with CDN, malware scanning and unlimited hack cleanups by Sucuri's own security team, blocklist monitoring and SSL support, sold per site on yearly plans.
best_for: site owners and small businesses who want a firewall in front of their site plus a security team that cleans up a hack for them, on WordPress or any other CMS and host
skip_if: you manage many client sites and want published self-serve pricing, or you only need a free security plugin for one WordPress site
honest_knock: Pricing is per site, so costs climb quickly for agencies, and plans for 10 or more sites have no published price. The cleanup times in the pricing table are described as estimated response times, not a guaranteed fix time. The refund rules disagree with each other: the terms tie the refund to not having submitted a malware removal request, while the help article ties it to no request having been completed. Cancelling needs a support ticket, not a button.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic Platform · one website, billed yearly
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-27 on sucuri.net/website-security-platform/signup/, both tabs; the help-centre and terms pages were read on 2026-10-15; dollar amounts, the page does not name the currency) Sucuri sells per website. The Security Platform plans each cover one site with unlimited malware and hack removals by Sucuri's team: Basic $229 a year (first ticket response 30 hours, scans every 12 hours), Pro $339 a year (12 hours, every 6 hours, advanced SSL support) and Business $549 a year (6 hours, every 30 minutes). Junior Dev is $999.98 a year for 5 sites (12 hours, every 6 hours). Multi-Site & Custom plans for 10 or more sites are priced on request. If you only want the firewall with CDN, without the cleanup service, the Firewall tab lists Basic at $9.99 a month and Pro at $19.98 a month, with multi-site on request. There is no free plan or free trial on the pricing page; Sucuri advertises a 30-day guarantee, and its free SiteCheck scanner and WordPress plugin are separate free tools.

schema_offer.description: Basic Platform, one website, billed yearly; Pro $339 and Business $549 a year, Junior Dev $999.98 a year for 5 sites; firewall-only plans $9.99 and $19.98 a month; dollar amounts, the page does not name the currency. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-27.

source_quotes.quote: within 30 days from when you subscribed or renewed

compare_with.name: a free security plugin
compare_with.why: free WordPress plugins, including Sucuri's own, can scan and harden a site at no cost. A paid Sucuri plan has to earn its price with what a plugin cannot do: a cloud firewall and CDN in front of the server, and cleanups done by Sucuri's team when a site is hacked
